versions.text: Criterion: Verify that safety protection functions/devices are safely implemented. Standard: The VCF has a safety program compatible with the air vehicle system for the VCF development, integration, manufacturing, and maintenance. The safety program defines that devices, procedures, or limitations implemented to accommodate failures do not cause loss of control/vehicle or pilot coupling. A single component failure is extremely remote (1x10^-9 or as specified by the procuring activity). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, simulation, inspection and review of documentation. The VCF safety program is verified by ensuring the use of MIL-STD-882, applicable DoD, Air Force Occupational Safety and Health (AFOSH) and Occupational Safety and Health Agency (OSHA) standards/guidelines, checklists, and evaluation matrix criteria. References: JSSG-2008: 3.1.5.3, 3.1.5.2, 3.1.5.4, 3.1.9, 3.1.11.1, 3.1.10, 3.1.11.1.1, 3.1.13 to 3.1.13.2, 3.1.16, 3.2.2.5.4.1, 3.2.4 through 3.2.4.6, associated section 4 paragraphs. MIL-STD-882 14 CFR 23.141-23.253, 25.21-25.255, 23.321-23.459, 25.321-25.459, 23.1501- 23.1529, 25.1501-25.1529.
